Princess Train' △'Who Are You in the Mirror?' △'Bubble Bubble, Wash Up!' △'Let's Find Your Charm!' △'Fly Again, Little Wings!' 등 총 5권으로 구성됐으며 세트 상품으로만 판매한다. 아이들에게 친숙한 캐릭터와 흥미로운 이야기를 활용해 영어에 대한 부담을 낮추고 자연스럽게 영어 읽기에 관심을 가질 수 있도록 구성한 것이 특징이다. 이번 제품은 기존 하드커버 형태에서 페이퍼북으로 제작 방식을 변경했다. 아이들이 좋아하는 티니핑 이야기를 보다 가볍고 친근한 형태로 접할 수 있도록 했으며 영어 학습을 돕는 음원 기능도 지원한다. 도서와 세이펜을 연동하면 영어 문장과 음원을 들으며 책을 읽을 수 있다. 세이펜이 없는 경우에도 QR코드를 통해 음원을 들을 수 있다. 아이들이 책을 눈으로 읽는 데 그치지 않고 영어 문장을 듣고 따라 하며 경험할 수 있도록 했다. 북메카 관계자는 “아이들이 좋아하는 캐릭터를 통해 영어를 처음 접하면 책 읽기에 대한 흥미와 즐거움을 자연스럽게 높일 수 있다”며 “앞으로도 아이들의 관심과 눈높이에 맞춘 다양한 영어 콘텐츠를 직접 기획하고 출판하겠다”고 말했다. 북메카는 미국과 영국, 호주 등 세계 10여개국 100여개 출판사와 공급 계약을 맺고 영유아 팝업북과 놀이형 도서, 그림책, 리더스북, 챕터북 등 다양한 영어 원서를 국내에 소개하고 있다. 해외 출판사의 도서를 수입·유통하는 데서 나아가 자체 출판으로 사업 영역을 확대하며 어린이 영어 콘텐츠 시장에서 경쟁력을 강화하고 있다. 신간은 행사 기간 서울 코엑스 A홀 731번 부스에서 만나볼 수 있다. 한편 유교전 유아교육전&베이비페어는 아이 교육과 관련 용품을 한자리에서 만나볼 수 있는 국내 최대 규모의 유아·아동 전시회다. 유은정 기자 judy6956@etnews.com 서울국제유아교육전&키즈페어(유교전)

items.t: Democrats launch Nvidia investigation, write scathing letter on Huang’s ‘scheme’ with Trump
items.d: This Congressional investigation into Nvidia's China sales and its dealings with Trump is the second one, so far, since news of the alleged spy affair broke.
items.fullText: Democrats on Thursday opened an inquiry into how the Trump administration handled Nvidia’s chip sales to China. Earlier on Thursday, the company ousted its CEO Jensen Huang . He also agreed to testify to a different set of Republican-led Congressional committees. Huang was removed from the company he founded after he confessed to an extramarital affair with a woman accused of being a Chinese spy. (He has since been accused of having more affairs , with Nvidia employees.) The alleged Chinese spy, Alice Huang, was an executive of Nvidia customer Megaspeed, a Singapore-based company that U.S. officials suspect of helping route advanced Nvidia chips into China. The Democratic inquiry comes from Rep. Richard Neal (D-Mass.), the top Democrat on the House Ways and Means Committee, and Sen. Ron Wyden (D-Ore.), the top Democrat on the Senate Finance Committee. As the minority party, they can ask questions but can’t compel answers. Their humdinger of a letter to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick asks the department to preserve records about an arrangement they find questionable and, they allege, illegal. “The scheme worked like this,” as the letter describes it. President Trump agreed to sales of Nvidia’s H200 chips to China as long as the chips, manufactured by Taiwan, were first shipped to the United States. On arriving, Trump added a tariff “effectively taking a cut of Nvidia’s sales to China through what appears to be an unconstitutional export tax system,” the letter said. Then the Commerce Department, under Lutnick, issued an export license. By the way, the deal between Trump and Nvidia to share revenue was public. In August 2025, Nvidia and AMD both agreed to share 15% of their revenue from chip sales to China with the U.S. government as part of a deal to secure export licenses, the AP reported at the time. items.t: Muse can now place calls to US businesses — if you pay
items.d: Muse's AI can now place outbound calls to U.S. businesses — but it's not free.
items.fullText: After initially testing the feature in September, Meta’s consumer AI agent Muse is now able to place calls to U.S. businesses on behalf of its users. However, only paid subscribers have access to the feature, the company says. Meta’s Muse, which now has over 10 million users , the company said last month, has been working to make consumer AI a mainstream product for everyday users. Placing calls is one of the ways it aims to get there, as it could handle another task on people’s to-do lists. Notes Alexandr Wang, Meta’s chief AI officer and head of its Superintelligence Labs division, the feature could be used to take care of calls people don’t want to make, like those to their cable company, the DMV, or to a restaurant that doesn’t offer online reservations. 🚨MUSE FEATURE ALERT!!!🚨 lots of you have been asking for this one… muse can make phone calls for you! ☎️📞📲 let muse take care of all those calls you don’t want to make. insurance? cable? DMV? dinner res? not your problem anymore. out now to paid subs in the US 🇺🇸 pic.twitter.com/dsyMNmI2Ub — Alexandr Wang (@alexandr_wang) November 12, 2026 Previously, only a select number of Muse early adopters were able to try this feature after asking the AI for access. Now, anyone who pays for Muse can make this type of request. Currently, Muse subscription plans start at $20 per month for 500 million Muse tokens per week. Heavier AI users can opt to pay $100 per month for 3 billion tokens. Muse is not the only AI agent able to place calls to businesses; the startup Instinct has been offering a similar option , as has Google’s Gemini . However, while the AI tools are now certainly capable of handling the task, the reception on the other end of the line can be mixed. Many businesses and receptionists hang up on calls from AI agents as soon as they identify that it’s not a human on the phone. items.t: Who is Colette Kress, Nvidia’s new interim CEO?
items.d: For 13 years, Colette Kress helped manage the company’s transformation from a graphics-chip maker into the company at the center of the AI boom.
items.fullText: Artificial intelligence Who is Colette Kress, Nvidia’s new interim CEO? The longtime finance chief takes over as interim CEO following Jensen Huang’s abrupt departure, inheriting a company facing investor uncertainty, congressional scrutiny and questions about its future leadership. Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 Nvidia's Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress. NVIDIA via Reuters Share Add NBC News to Google Nov. 12, 2026, 2:57 PM EST By Jane Lytvynenko For 13 years, Colette Kress helped manage the company’s transformation from a graphics-chip maker into the company at the center of the artificial intelligence boom. Now, she’s being asked to lead it through one of the most turbulent moments in its history. Kress, Nvidia’s chief financial officer, was named interim CEO Thursday following the abrupt resignation of Jensen Huang, who co-founded the company and led it for 33 years. Huang’s departure comes amid revelations of extramarital relationships with an alleged Chinese spy and one of his own reports. “We will continue advancing the work that has made Nvidia a leader in accelerated computing and AI, and execute on the opportunities ahead,” Kress said in a press release. “Our focus remains on serving our customers, partners, developers and shareholders.” “I believe deeply in this company and in its future. More than anything, I believe in each of you, in our customers and partners and in the vital role we play every day in the global economy,” Kress said in an email to staff following her appointment, acknowledging the “extraordinarily difficult period” for the company. items.t: Phota Labs uses AI to turn everyday photos into professional-looking shots
items.d: Rather than giving consumers yet another photo-editing tool, Phota Labs aims to use advances in AI to automate the editing process so it’s easier for anyone to turn everyday moments into better photos.
items.fullText: A new iOS app called Phota Labs gives users access to a personal AI photo assistant that turns everyday snapshots into images that look like they were taken by a professional photographer, all while preserving the authenticity of the image. Rather than giving consumers yet another photo-editing tool, Phota Labs aims to use advances in AI to automate the editing process so it’s easier for anyone to get access to better photos. The a16z-backed startup was founded by Cecilia Zhang and Zach Xia, who met at Adobe while working on computational photography products, including Project Indigo, Lightroom, and Photoshop. The duo saw a gap in the editing tools on the market and believed that although editing tools can be powerful for enhancing photos, they aren’t very effective at fixing a photo that wasn’t captured well in the first place. Phota Labs changes that by focusing on fixing the shot itself while preserving the natural appearances of those in the image. “Phota is your personal photo assistant that can make great photos for any moment you want to keep before you even ask, which means that it’s a very proactive experience,” Zhang told TechCrunch in an interview. “Think of it almost like a photographer or virtual photographer who looks over your camera roll and tries to understand what’s happening and how they could have taken that photo for you on the spot for that scene.” Image Credits: Phota Labs The idea is to use AI to transform photos, whether that’s turning a wide-angle group photo into a tighter portrait or transforming a selfie into a regular shot. Users can choose from different photography styles that determine how AI transforms their images, ranging from subtle edits that preserve the original lens and composition to more dramatic transformations that introduce effects like fish-eye lenses, alternative angles, and entirely different perspectives. items.t: Jensen Huang agrees to testify before Congress
items.d: Huang, who was ousted as CEO following reports of an alleged affair with a woman suspected of spying for China, agreed to testify Wednesday after several senior lawmakers threatened to subpoena him.
items.fullText: In Brief Posted: 8:36 AM PST · November 12, 2026 Image Credits: Jose Sarmento Matos/Bloomberg / Getty Images Aisha Malik Jensen Huang agrees to testify before Congress Ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has agreed to testify before Congress, House Foreign Affairs Committee Chairman Brian Mast said on Thursday, according to reports from Bloomberg and NBC News . Huang, who stepped down as CEO following reports of an alleged affair with a woman suspected of spying for China, agreed to testify Wednesday after several senior lawmakers threatened to subpoena him. Huang has agreed to testify before Congress by Thanksgiving, which falls later this month. The development comes after House Republicans Mast, John Moolenaar, and Rick Crawford sent Huang a letter on November 4 requesting that he appear before their committees . Moolenaar chairs the House Select Committee on the Chinese Communist Party, Mast chairs the House Committee on Foreign Affairs, and Crawford chairs the House Intelligence Committee. “Jensen and I have been very at odds as some of you already know on export controls, but Nvidia is a very important company to the United States of America,” Mast said to reporters. “I don’t want to see anything hurt in Nvidia, but he has some very serious questions to answer.” The testimony will take place behind closed doors, though Mast said he expects the briefing to be recorded on video and transcribed. items.t: Trump floats Apple chairman Tim Cook as Jensen Huang’s successor
items.d: In a post on Truth Social, President Trump says only one man can take Jensen Huang's place as head of Nvidia: Tim Cook.
items.fullText: In Brief Posted: 8:12 AM PST · November 12, 2026 Image Credits: Kevin Dietsch / Getty Images Sarah Perez Trump floats Apple chairman Tim Cook as Jensen Huang’s successor In the wake of the industry-shaking news of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s resignation on Thursday, U.S. President Donald Trump is floating the idea that former Apple CEO Tim Cook should take over the position. In a post on Truth Social, Trump wrote that “only one man” could take Huang’s place: Tim Cook of Apple. “A Legend replaces a Legend!” he wrote. Cook stepped down as Apple’s CEO on September 1, 2026, after 15 years running the company , but he’s still very much involved with Apple. While John Ternus took over as Apple’s CEO, Cook transitioned into the role of executive chairman of Apple’s board of directors, which sees him continuing to engage with global policymakers and manage international relationships, including Apple’s relations with China. Trump is not the only one to suggest Cook as a replacement for Huang. Jeffrey Sonnenfeld , Senior Associate Dean for Leadership Studies at Yale School of Management, who studies CEO leadership and corporate governance, penned an op-ed in Time on Wednesday , suggesting Cook should be among the potential candidates. He wrote that Cook has “an unparalleled track record of succeeding a bigger-than-life founder,” in reference to Cook taking over from Apple founder Steve Jobs. Whether or not Trump agrees with this opinion, or is simply blasting off an idea that hopped into his mind, is anyone’s guess. “Tim Nvidia,” however, doesn’t quite have the same ring as “Tim Apple” does . items.t: Jensen Huang is out at Nvidia — who is Colette Kress, his interim replacement?
items.d: Nvidia CFO Colette Kress is taking over as an interim replacement for longtime CEO Jensen Huang, who is embroiled in scandal.
items.fullText: The Nvidia Board of Directors announced on Thursday morning that the company’s co-founder and CEO of 33 years, Jensen Huang, has resigned as president, CEO, and member of the board, effective immediately. This is a shocking twist for one of the most valuable companies in the world, which designs the chips that make the AI boom possible. Few people would have predicted this turn of events even just a week ago, as Huang has been so central to Nvidia throughout the company’s existence that he never even established a succession plan . But Huang has now been ousted after reports that he had affairs with both an alleged Chinese spy and one of his direct reports at Nvidia. While the company conducts a more thorough search for Huang’s successor, Nvidia CFO and Executive Vice President Colette Kress has taken over as interim CEO. But beyond her name and job title, what do we know about the person who will now lead a company worth about $3.8 trillion? According to Nvidia’s website , Kress has worked at the company since September 2013. Before that, she spent three years as an SVP and CFO of Cisco’s Business Technology Operations Finance organization. She also worked at Microsoft for 13 years, where she spent four years as CFO of the Server and Tools division. She holds a finance degree from the University of Arizona and an MBA from Southern Methodist University. The California-based 59-year-old has a very limited social media presence — on Linkedin , she has commented some well wishes on former colleagues’ posts about their retirement. But as CFO, she’s been a regular presence on Nvidia’s earnings calls, making her a familiar figure for analysts covering the company. According to Forbes’ list of America’s Richest Self-Made Women, Kress’ net worth is estimated to be about $1.2 billion. items.t: Cyberattack on Fireworks AI allowed hackers to access Notion customers’ chat transcripts
items.d: This is Fireworks' second data breach in as many months.
items.fullText: A cyberattack at Fireworks AI has exposed some of its customers’ data, the company has confirmed. Fireworks AI, a platform that developers use to access and use open AI models, said an attacker breached its cloud provider to gain access to a Fireworks development system, which allowed access to some of its customers’ data. The company said in its latest security advisory that the cybercriminals took Fireworks’ customers’ billing information and some datasets. Fireworks touts tens of thousands of customers worldwide using its platform, including legal tech company Harvey and AI company Cursor. At least one confirmed affected customer is online document editor and notetaker Notion, which said in a disclosure that the breach affected around 1% of its own customers. Notion said that Fireworks alerted the company to a security incident and later confirmed that the hackers had stolen some Notion customer data. On November 3, Notion said it disconnected its systems from Fireworks, deleted the data stored in its systems, and stopped all connectivity between the two. Notion confirmed this week that the hackers took chat transcripts of its Notion AI customers who used the “Insights” feature. The company said that the transcripts include “any input to or output from the model that was written to the chat,” but added that much of the data was unattributable and could not be determined from which customer it was obtained. The breach at Fireworks AI shows how tech companies are reliant on other tech providers for their own offerings, and how cyberattacks can, as a result, spill over into other customers. Fireworks said that it believes the hackers are financially motivated and that their goals are focused on selling tokens from breaching access to large language models, or LLMs. These schemes rely on selling to unauthorized third parties, who can burn through AI model usage without using their own resources. items.fullText: NVIDIA Dynamo Recipes Bring Korea’s Leading Open Models to Production November 8, 2026 by Amr Elmeleegy 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! NVIDIA is releasing Dynamo-optimized deployment recipes for Korea’s leading open models: A.X K2 from SK Telecom , K-EXAONE 2.0 from LG AI Research , Solar Open 2 from Upstage and Motif-3 from Motif Technologies . As models grow beyond the capacity of a single GPU, they must be split across multiple GPUs, requiring careful coordination of request routing and communication to maintain performance. NVIDIA Dynamo is an open source, distributed inference-serving framework built to deploy models in multi-node environments at data center scale. It handles this routing and communication to maximize inference performance. Optimized for NVIDIA B200 GPUs, these recipes take the guesswork out of deployment, delivering up to 2x performance out of the box. They help developers bring Korea’s open models into production faster and turn them into broadly accessible AI for All services. Learn more about NVIDIA Dynamo . items.fullText: How NVIDIA Open Source Tools Are Helping Researchers Build Next-Generation 6G Networks With over a million downloads, NVIDIA’s open source 5G/6G tools are equipping research institutions worldwide to develop wireless systems that help robots react faster, improve signal reception and match network capacity to demand. November 6, 2026 by Soma Velayutham 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Your browser doesn't support HTML5 video. Here is a link to the video instead. A year ago, NVIDIA open sourced its Aerial wireless software , joining Sionna and a broader suite of open source tools for accelerating next-generation 6G network development. Together, they give researchers a foundation for testing ideas, comparing results and building on each other’s work — connecting simulation and AI training with experiments on real over-the-air wireless systems. Today, researchers and developers are using these tools to build 6G-ready networks that do more than just transmit data — receiving signals more effectively, keeping robots and autonomous systems connected when it matters most, and adapting in real time as devices move through the world. Over the past year, global developer adoption of NVIDIA AI Aerial and NVIDIA Sionna software has grown 10x, while NVIDIA’s open source 5G/6G tools have surpassed 1 million downloads. More than 8,000 research and academic institutions worldwide are using these platforms. The projects emerging today offer a view of how future networks could look. Each addresses a different challenge, but together point toward a broader ambition for building AI-native 6G networks that deliver connectivity, computing and sensing over a converged software-defined platform for billions of people, machines and agents. items.fullText: Vera Delivers the Best of Both Worlds: Highest Throughput and Fastest Agents November 5, 2026 by Hannah Coutand 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! AI agents do more than generate answers. They search for information, query databases, write and test code and take action. Each of those steps relies on a CPU, with agents moving between GPU reasoning and CPU execution throughout a task. As businesses put more agents to work, AI factories need CPUs that can execute those steps quickly and support many agents at once, all within the limits of available power. What this means: AI infrastructure providers need to support more agents without making each one wait longer to get work done. And critically, AI factories are power limited. This means operators need to choose infrastructure that maximizes the work done for every watt. Why it matters: NVIDIA Vera delivers both fast agent performance and high capacity per watt within a single CPU. That gives providers one CPU for a range of agent workloads, rather than having to mix and match fast and dense x86 parts to balance speed and capacity. The data that proves it: In a 100-megawatt data center comparison, NVIDIA found that a single Vera CPU performs better than the fastest x86 CPU and the most energy-efficient x86 CPU. Vera delivers industry-leading agent speed while enabling 1.6x more agents per watt versus the fastest x86 CPU. Vera delivers 2x faster agent speed with leading energy efficiency compared with the most energy-efficient x86 CPU. Partners are already putting Vera to work. Early adopters see the same exceptional performance in production-style tests: Perplexity : Ran agentic coding tasks 1.5x faster with Vera than on traditional CPUs. Perplexity plans to deploy Vera in an upcoming production system. items.fullText: More Performance From Every Byte: How Full-Stack Codesign Solves AI’s Memory Challenge November 5, 2026 by Amr Elmeleegy 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Larger models, longer contexts and agentic applications are increasing GPU memory pressure while supply tightens and prices rise — a trend expected to continue through the near term. NVIDIA works closely with memory partners to rapidly adopt the latest memory technologies. NVIDIA was first to adopt HBM3e and HBM4 technologies into an accelerated computing stack. But the approach isn’t to simply pack more memory onto the GPU. It’s full-stack codesign. NVIDIA intentionally designs GPUs, CPUs, networking, storage and software together to get more useful work out of memory at every layer of the AI factory. That matters because an AI factory runs on a memory and storage hierarchy. GPU high-bandwidth memory (HBM) is the fastest, most expensive and most contested tier — with model weights and KV cache competing for limited capacity. Below it sit CPU memory, local SSDs and shared storage, each trading speed for more capacity at a lower cost per bit. How much useful work a byte does depends on how well the whole hierarchy is used: shrinking what must be stored, placing it on the right tier and bringing it back to the GPU before it’s needed. Byte for byte, NVIDIA makes the most efficient use of memory at every layer — and the results show it. From NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra to the Vera Rubin platform, HBM capacity per GPU rose roughly 3%, while agentic throughput per dollar rose by up to 30x on SemiAnalysis AgentX. Agentic Inference Is Putting More Pressure on HBM Frontier models now have trillions of parameters — the values that hold what an AI model learned in training. KV cache, which holds the context the model needs to understand each active request without reprocessing the same information, is also expanding. items.fullText: AI Is Changing How Semiconductor Fabs Work — and Engineers Are Moving Faster Because of It An AI-defined fab uses accelerated simulation, learned physics models and AI agents to give engineers faster answers across design, testing and manufacturing. November 3, 2026 by Timothy Costa 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Your browser doesn't support HTML5 video. Here is a link to the video instead. Demand for advanced chips is rising. The processes to build them are getting more complex. And the margin for error is shrinking. For engineers, understanding how a process change will behave, how a material will interact with a new step, how a defect maps back to a root cause are critical, challenging steps in semiconductor manufacturing — and these analyses can take days. Physical experiments on a fab line are slow and expensive. A wrong call on yield or process quality has real consequences. AI is transforming semiconductor manufacturing, impacting what engineers can do — and how fast. Accelerated computing shortens simulation time, allowing engineers to evaluate more alternatives before committing to physical trials. Physics-based AI helps engineers predict process behavior without running a full simulation every time. AI agents handle sequences of engineering tasks that once consumed hours. And digital twins let teams test changes in a virtual environment before committing to physical trials. Together, these capabilities describe an AI-defined fab: a semiconductor manufacturing factory where AI helps engineers optimize processes, catch problems earlier and make better decisions across the full manufacturing chip lifecycle. Engineers direct the work and make decisions based on their expertise while spending less time waiting for answers.
